name: getty
description: Plugins by Getty for Claude Code and Codex — skill distribution, subagent briefing, and whatever comes next.

plugins.name: agent-irc
plugins.description: Mirrors a session's activity into IRC: prompts, tool calls with durations, subagents, token usage. One nick per session.

plugins.name: briefing
plugins.description: Programmatic briefing beats prompt stuffing. Pre-loads declared skills into a subagent's context at spawn time, so it wakes up already briefed.

plugins.name: loadguard
plugins.description: Keeps AI-issued shell commands from taking down the host: each session runs in its own systemd scope with memory and CPU limits, and under memory pressure heavy commands (test suites, builds, headless agents, anything it has seen eat a fifth of the RAM) are refused with the reason told to the model. Linux only.

plugins.name: manage-skills
plugins.description: Hardlink-based skill sharing across projects — one source of truth per skill, hardlinks everywhere else. Puts the manage-skills CLI on PATH and ships its own skills.

plugins.name: ruler
plugins.description: Keeps CLAUDE.md and the rules without paths in context across every compaction, and their copies out of the compaction summary.

plugins.name: skilletor
plugins.description: Remote skills, agents and rules for Claude Code and Codex — declared once in skilletor.json, synced on every session, templated per project. Adds sources like marketplaces and puts the skilletor CLI on PATH.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Cross-project skills for Claude Code and Codex — Perl house style and release tooling, git conventions, Kubernetes and container operations, PostgreSQL with pgvector and Apache AGE, plugin engineering for Claude Code, Codex and Hermes Agent, and the craft of writing skills themselves. Only what has no single home of its own.
